## Personality

Mary Joe is an exceptionally particular woman who takes great pride in her housekeeping. She is also skeptical of dream-people, holding the view that experiencing them is a sign that a person's mind is touched.

_Sources: [v2 XI Facts and Fancies P33](../source/v02-c11.md#nw-v02-c11-p0033), [v2 XXVII An Afternoon at the Stone House P62](../source/v02-c27.md#nw-v02-c27-p0062)_

## History

Mary Joe was a healthy French girl hired by Mrs. [Pembroke](../character/pembroke.md) to take care of her children while she was away. Later, she suffered from failing health, raising concern over her well-being and the uncertain future of the Farrow twins.

_Sources: [v1 CHAPTER XVIII. Nell to the Rescue P28](../source/v01-c18.md#nw-v01-c18-p0028), [v2 VII The Pointing of Duty P4](../source/v02-c07.md#nw-v02-c07-p0004), [v2 VII The Pointing of Duty P12](../source/v02-c07.md#nw-v02-c07-p0012), [v2 VII The Pointing of Duty P23](../source/v02-c07.md#nw-v02-c07-p0023), [v2 VII The Pointing of Duty P32](../source/v02-c07.md#nw-v02-c07-p0032)_

## Quotes

> "Dat Cedric, he is de queeres’ leetle boy. He talks dat queer. I tink dere’s someting wrong in his upper story."
>
> — Mary Joe — [v2 XIX Just a Happy Day P14](../source/v02-c19.md#nw-v02-c19-p0014)

> "Well, yous are de queer leetle boy. Yous make me feel scare."
>
> — Mary Joe — [v2 XIX Just a Happy Day P28](../source/v02-c19.md#nw-v02-c19-p0028)

> "Well, yous do beat all de kids I ever knowed."
>
> — Mary Joe — [v2 XIX Just a Happy Day P3](../source/v02-c19.md#nw-v02-c19-p0003)

> "Well, yous are de queer one. Dare ain’t no such ting as fairies."
>
> — Mary Joe — [v2 XIX Just a Happy Day P28](../source/v02-c19.md#nw-v02-c19-p0028)
